intro: In Sen'jin Village, Master Gadrin guides the Darkspear through exile and loss. The elder witch doctor once trained the tribe's priests and mages with Zalazane. Now he helps his people and seeks to break the dark curse over their home on the Echo Isles.

p: Before the Darkspear reached Kalimdor, Master Gadrin guided generations of his people in the South Seas. He served as a witch doctor on the islands they called home, teaching the tribe's mystical ways.

On the Echo Isles, Master Gadrin and the young witch doctor Zalazane trained the tribe's priests and mages together. Zalazane fell under the pull of the dark voodoo he sought to wield, and madness took hold. He enslaved the minds of his people and drove Vol'jin and the uncorrupted Darkspear onto the mainland of Durotar. Now in Sen'jin Village, Gadrin bears the grief of watching a companion become a tyrant. He works to lay slain tribesfolk to rest and end Zalazane's rule.

Master Gadrin knows more of troll spiritualism and loa lore than almost anyone alive in the Horde. Scholars, shamans, and the Royal Apothecary Society seek his counsel on arcane and alchemical mysteries. When the Burning Blade threatens Durotar, or distant researchers need forgotten rites, Gadrin draws on what he knows. He sends adventurers to Zul'Farrak to read the tablet that holds Shadra the spider loa's true name. Then he crafts the binding such a rite requires.
